stepHints.CATALOG: Find the partner's offer in the catalogue of its connector (DSP).
stepHints.NEGOTIATION: Negotiate a usage contract for the offer; policies are evaluated.
stepHints.TRANSFER: Start the transfer process for the exchange.
stepHints.EDR: Obtain a short-lived access token (EDR) for the partner's data plane.
stepHints.DELIVERY: Send the message to the partner's system via its data plane.
stepHints.RECEIPT: Message received via the own data plane and stored unchanged.
stepHints.KEY_FETCH: Partner's public signing key fetched via Catena-X.
stepHints.DTR_LOOKUP: Looked up the case's digital twin in the supplier's registry (DTR) by exchange ID.
stepHints.SHELL_DESCRIPTOR: Read the digital twin's descriptor and found the entry for the revision.
stepHints.SUBMODEL_FETCH: Retrieved the PPF package via the supplier's data plane.
stepHints.HASH_CHECK: Compared the SHA-256 of the retrieved data with the expected value to rule out changes on the way.
stepHints.SIGNATURE_CHECK: Verified the supplier's digital signature with their public key.
stepHints.DOCUMENT_FETCH: Retrieved the document via the partner's data plane and stored it in your own storage.
stepHints.TWIN_REGISTRATION: Registered the digital twin and package descriptor in your own registry (DTR) – visible to the customer only.

tab.intro: Messages and retrievals run exclusively through both partners' Catena-X connectors: find the offer in the catalogue, negotiate the contract, obtain the access token and deliver or retrieve. Every step is traceable here.
tab.emptyDescription: As soon as a message for this case is sent or received, it appears here with all steps.
tab.emptyManual: This case was captured manually. The customer is not connected to Catena-X, so no messages are exchanged.
tab.emptyLegacy: Legacy case from a previous system – without data exchange via Catena-X.
tab.loadError: Could not load the data exchange.

EDC.text: Eclipse Dataspace Connector – each participant's connector. Data only flows through it, never directly between systems.

DSP.text: Dataspace Protocol – the standard connectors use to query catalogues and negotiate usage contracts.

EDR.text: Endpoint Data Reference – short-lived access token for the partner's data plane, issued after a successful negotiation.

DTR.text: Digital Twin Registry – directory in which the supplier registers a digital twin per case pointing to the PPF package. The customer finds the package there and retrieves it via Catena-X.

submitted.description: The revision is stored immutably and is being transmitted to the customer via Catena-X.
submitted.descriptionManual: The revision is stored immutably. The customer is not connected to Catena-X – transmit the package through the agreed channel.
submitted.descriptionPull: The revision is stored immutably and provided in your digital twin. The customer retrieves it via Catena-X at its next poll (pull mode).

cockpit.title: Connector cockpit
cockpit.description: Status of your EDC connection and all messages exchanged via Catena-X.

messages.title: Messages
messages.emptyDescription: Sent and received messages appear here with status and steps.

drawer.title: Message
drawer.description: Steps, identifiers and payload for diagnosis.

PUSH.hint: The supplier sent the complete package to the customer as a Catena-X message.

PULL.hint: The supplier only provided the package in their digital twin; the customer collected it during its regular polling.

PUSH_NOTIFY_PULL_PAYLOAD.hint: The supplier notified the customer; the customer then retrieved the package from the supplier's digital twin.

twin.title: Digital twin
twin.description: This case's entry in your digital twin registry. The customer uses it to find your submissions and retrieve them via Catena-X.
twin.visibilityHint: The identifiers are visible to the customer only (externalSubjectId), not public.
twin.emptyDescription: The digital twin is registered in your registry with the first submission in pull or notification + pull mode.
twin.loadError: Digital twin could not be loaded.
twin.emptyPush: In push mode no digital twin is registered – the customer receives the complete package as a message.
